fields.description: Personal API Token from ClickUp → Settings → Apps.
fields.label: API Token

fields.description: Prepended to a task's ID to build its link (e.g. "Open in ClickUp"). Edit this to match your workspace's actual task URL format if it differs — whatever you put here is glued directly in front of the task ID, no slash is added automatically.
fields.label: Task URL Prefix

fields.description: One ClickUp status per line (case-insensitive), e.g. "Ready for Deploy". Only tasks in one of these statuses can be fetched into a Deployment Plan. Leave empty to allow any status.
fields.label: Allowed Statuses
